automatic.title: Find your inverter
automatic.description: Detected networks: {networks}. Confirm or edit the private IPv4 range. Large networks use a suggested /24 range; you can scan another range up to /22. The search runs from Home Assistant, reads identification only and takes up to 45 seconds.

choose.title: Inverters found
choose.description: Select your inverter by serial number and IP address. Identification confirms a Deye-compatible inverter, not a particular dongle model.

not_found.title: No compatible inverter found
not_found.description:
Check that the dongle and Home Assistant share a reachable LAN, Modbus TCP is enabled on port 502, and Slave ID is 1. Networks behind a router or Docker may require another range or a manual IP. Hosts with port 502 open that did not identify as an inverter:
{details}

inverter_replaced.title: Inverter replaced?
inverter_replaced.description: The inverter at this address now reports serial number {new_serial} instead of {old_serial}. Confirm only if the inverter was replaced: this device and its entities are kept and move to the new serial number, and the Auto profile is detected again. If you set an exact model, a manual profile or additional options for the previous inverter, review them.

board.title: Atodosol home automation board
board.description: If the board has a PIN, enter it here to change its settings from Home Assistant. The board cannot check a PIN without changing a setting: it is checked the first time you change something. To set, change or remove the PIN, use the board page.

data_description.host: Accepted only if this same board answers at the new address.
data_description.pin: Leave it empty if the board has no PIN. It has 4 to 8 digits.
data_description.scan_interval: Between 10 and 300. The board serves one connection at a time: 15 seconds or more is recommended.
